name: sheet
title: Sheet
description: Bottom sheet on phones that drags down to close, centred dialog on bigger screens. Escape closes the top one; the page stays locked until all are gone.
docs:
Sheet needs these transitions.dev snippets in the app:

  npx transitions-dev add modal

Load obvious's primitives and a theme first, then the transitions.dev CSS, then obvious/css/transitions-bridge.css, so the colours come from the theme.
